title: tinv
summary: Evaluate the inverse Student's t cumulative distribution function.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until a provider hook exists.

description: `tinv(p,nu)` returns the Student's t quantile for probability `p` and degrees of freedom `nu`.
behaviors: `p` and `nu` may be scalars or matching-size numeric arrays.
Scalar inputs broadcast over matching-size array inputs.

faqs.question: How is tinv computed?
faqs.answer: RunMat solves against the Student's t CDF with a bounded bisection path, using symmetry around zero.
